components.name: Distribution row
components.description: Exact-value chart row with hover preview, visible keyboard focus and pinned selection. Dashes are preview placeholders; production values and percentages come from the complete supplied dataset.
components.css: .ds-distribution-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:10px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:4px 9px;text-align:left;width:100%;min-height:52px;min-width:0;padding:9px 7px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms,border-color 150ms}.ds-distribution-row:hover{background:var(--surface-2,#f7f9fd)}.ds-distribution-row[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#2563eb) 40%,var(--border,#dbe3f0));background:var(--primary-weak,#ebf2ff)}.ds-distribution-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#2563eb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-distribution-marker{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c1,#2563eb)}.ds-distribution-title{color:var(--text,#17243b);font:500 12px/1.4 var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-distribution-percent{color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a);font:500 11px var(--font-mono,"JetBrains Mono",monospace);text-align:right}.ds-distribution-value{grid-column:2/-1;display:flex;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;color:var(--text,#17243b);font:400 12px var(--font-mono,"JetBrains Mono",monospace);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-distribution-value small{color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a);font:10px var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-distribution-row{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-report-export-menu{width:min(268px,calc(100vw - 40px));background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--border,#dbe3f0);border-radius:12px;padding:6px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg,0 16px 40px rgba(16,24,40,.14),0 4px 10px rgba(16,24,40,.06));font-family:var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);transform-origin:top right}.ds-report-export-menu p{margin:6px 9px 9px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a)}.ds-report-export-menu button{width:100%;min-height:46px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#17243b);border-radius:7px;font:400 12px var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-report-export-menu button>:last-child{margin-inline-start:auto}.ds-report-export-menu button:hover:not(:disabled),.ds-report-export-menu button:focus-visible{background:var(--primary-weak,#ebf2ff);color:var(--primary,#2563eb);outline:none}.ds-report-export-menu button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:default}.ds-report-export-format{width:38px;font:500 9px var(--font-mono,"JetBrains Mono",monospace);letter-spacing:.04em;padding:5px 0;text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--border,#dbe3f0);border-radius:4px}

narrative.overview: Alpha POS puts restaurant activity, reporting and daily work in one readable workspace. Its visual direction comes from the user's legacy admin reference and the earlier approved Forest theme.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Read canonical tokens; do not hard-code a second palette inside a page.

dos: Preserve fields, actions, permissions, translations, date semantics and backend contracts.
Keep loading, error, empty, stale and populated states distinct; keep all chart categories accessible.
Keep phone targets reachable and test full control visibility at 320px as well as 390px.
Keep chart share scope visible and every returned category, product and person reachable through exact-value controls.
Keep accounting-report money exact and incomplete historical cost visible through warnings and unavailable-value dashes.
donts: Do not invent live-looking totals or replace missing financial values with zero.
Do not turn a displayed subset into a period-wide denominator or normalized staff measures into performance scores.
Do not copy obsolete decorative eyebrows, oversized blank KPI stacks or clipped composer layouts.
